flows.result: Authenticated host actor, masters and patient records; no browser seed
One selected-module search palette finds the real patient
Four-step registration persists into the dynamic wristband record after reload
Same-key replay returns the same patient; changed content conflicts; patient audit reads
Patient episode created with an API master department
Outpatient visit creates the Episode → Case → Encounter relationship
Encounter advances from arrived through in progress to completed
Admission request links the completed visit; UI deposit clears the pending request
Cleared IP request allocates a bed; duplicate admission refuses; discharge releases it
Completed case and episode close through source guards
Viewer reads; writes, module login and reset refuse; another branch excludes the new patient
Mounted registration survives Arabic RTL, Hindi, Malayalam and English; effective theme/font/radius/shortcuts update
